extracted.intended_audience: ACUS members, committee members, researchers, staff, and others involved in developing or submitting recommendations to the Administrative Conference
extracted.subtask_description: Steps and procedural requirements for developing, reviewing, adopting, and implementing formal recommendations through the Administrative Conference Project Process, from idea selection through plenary adoption and implementation activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gathering and selecting ideas for a project
rubrics_metrics.description: The process includes gathering and selecting ideas for a project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the initial step in the Administrative Conference Project Process—identifying potential topics or issues that could form the basis of a research project and eventual recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Getting Council approval
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After idea selection, the proposed project must be approved by the Conference's Council before proceeding to researcher selection and research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selecting the researcher
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once a project is approved by the Council, an appropriate researcher is selected to perform the research that will inform the committee's consideration and drafting of a recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Researcher's report considered by a committee
rubrics_metrics.description: Having the researcher’s report considered by a committee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The researcher's findings are reviewed by a designated committee, which evaluates the report and uses it as the evidentiary basis for formulating a recommendation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee formulates a recommendation
rubrics_metrics.description: Having the selected committee formulate a recommendation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The committee, on the basis of the research report and deliberation, drafts a formal recommendation for consideration by the Council and Conference membership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee's recommendation considered by the Council and then the full Conference membership
rubrics_metrics.description: Having a committee’s recommendation considered by the Council and then the full Conference membership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After a committee formulates a recommendation, it is reviewed first by the Council and subsequently presented to the full Conference membership for deliberation prior to adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption by voting members at semi-annual plenary sessions
rubrics_metrics.description: Recommendations are adopted by the voting members of the Conference at semi-annual plenary sessions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final adoption occurs during the Conference's semi-annual plenary meetings, where voting members approve recommendations for issuance and further action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation activities
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Following adoption, the Conference undertakes implementation activities to promote, monitor, or assist in the application of the recommendation(s) in administrative practice.
